# nobus_fos_objects (Data Source)

Lists objects in a Nobus FOS container.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nobus_fos_objects" "assets" {
  container_name = "terraform-assets"
  prefix         = "releases/"
  full_listing   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
